dedupe_keys.name: french polynesia corrected tide gauge observations

description: The Geodesy Observatory of Tahiti archives corrected sea-level observations from five French Polynesian tide gauges with NOAA NCEI. Vairao, Mangareva, Tubuai, Makemo and Rangiroa cover 13 June 2009 to 28 January 2021 at one- or two-minute sampling, with hourly smoothed products described by the article. The provider's public ISO metadata confirms the collection and online distribution; the ordinary landing page currently returns a service error. Data.gov labels the deposit CC0, and NOAA states that normal electronic access is free. NOAA's current metadata says public access, conflicting with Data.gov's non-public label. Timestamp corrections and outlier flags improve use, but flagged values remain and station datums require care. The observations can validate tsunami and coastal-flood simulations around island infrastructure. They complement GESLA with a specifically curated regional series. Original file formats and actual downloads were not checked.
